secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon key for the Steam Room App project (public, browser-safe). Get it from the Supabase dashboard > Settings > API > anon public key.

secrets.name: YOCO_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Yoco secret API key for creating checkout sessions. Get it from the Yoco developer dashboard.

secrets.name: YOCO_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Yoco webhook signing secret for verifying payment confirmations. Get it from the Yoco developer dashboard.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for server-side admin operations. Get it from the Supabase dashboard > Settings > API > service_role key.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Supabase database password for local CLI development. Get it from the Supabase dashboard > Settings > Database.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: Supabase CLI access token for linking to the remote project. Get it from the Supabase dashboard > Account > Access Tokens.
